name: Karka
personality: Compassionate, caring, intuitive, emotional, family-oriented, and protective.
relationships: Deeply caring and devoted. Values emotional security, family, and long-lasting relationships.
health: Chest, lungs, breasts, stomach, digestive system, emotional well-being.
description: Karka is the fourth sign of the zodiac, representing emotions, home, family, nourishment, and protection. Ruled by the Moon, it symbolizes compassion, intuition, sensitivity, and a deep connection to loved ones.
